generationInputs.prompt: A middle-aged woman with light skin and long, wavy white hair parted slightly off-center smiles at the camera. She is wearing light-framed eyeglasses, gold hoop earrings, and a delicate gold necklace with a small pendant. She has a light gray v-neck top layered under a light beige cardigan. Her lips are slightly parted, revealing her upper teeth. In front of her on a dark gray countertop are three round fruits: one peach with red and yellow tones, one green lime, and one bright orange. To the right of the fruits is a teal bowl with a lighter green interior, holding three light green apples. Behind the woman is a white tiled backsplash. Two light brown wooden shelves are mounted on the wall. The top shelf holds a small terracotta pot with a green plant, a silver cylindrical container, and a larger terracotta pot. The lower shelf holds a white bowl with a green plant and a larger white bowl. To the left is a silver kettle on the countertop and a blurred window or doorway showing greenery. The lighting is soft and diffused, coming from the front.
